#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = (int) 1e8;

struct Node {
    Node *left, *right;
    int batchSetValue;
    bool dirty;
    int minVal;

    Node() : left(nullptr), right(nullptr), batchSetValue(0), dirty(false), minVal(0) {}

    inline void pushUp() {
        minVal = std::min(left->minVal, right->minVal);
    }

    inline void setValue(int val) {
        minVal = val;
        batchSetValue = val;
        dirty = true;
    }

    inline void pushDown() {
        if (dirty) {
            if (left != nullptr) left->setValue(batchSetValue);
            if (right != nullptr) right->setValue(batchSetValue);
            dirty = false;
        }
    }

    static Node* build(int l, int r) {
        Node* node = new Node();
        if (l != r) {
            int m = (l + r) >> 1;
            node->left = build(l, m);
            node->right = build(m + 1, r);
        }
        return node;
    }

    static int query(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
        if (f <= l && r <= t) return node->minVal;
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        return std::min(query(f, t, l, m, node->left), query(f, t, m + 1, r, node->right));
    }

    static void update(int i, int l, int r, int val, Node* node) {
        if (i > r || i < l) return;
        if (l == r) {
            node->minVal = std::min(node->minVal, val);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        update(i, l, m, val, node->left);
        update(i, m + 1, r, val, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }

    static void toArray(int l, int r, int* data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            data[l] = node->minVal;
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        toArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        toArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
    }

    static void fromArray(int l, int r, int* data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            node->minVal = data[l];
            return;
        }
        node->dirty = false;
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fromArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fromArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
        node->pushUp();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<vector<int>> intervals(k + 2, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> intervals[i][0] >> intervals[i][1];
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

    k++;
    Node* loop[2];
    loop[0] = Node::build(0, n);
    loop[1] = Node::build(0, n);

    vector<int> data(n + 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        Node* curDp = loop[i & 1];
        Node* lastDp = loop[(i - 1) & 1];

        int* interval = &intervals[i][0];
        int intervalLength = interval[1] - interval[0];
        int middleLength = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        Node::toArray(0, n, data.data(), lastDp);
        std::copy(data.begin(), data.begin() + std::min<int>(data.size(), intervalLength + middleLength),
                  data.begin() + std::max<int>(0, n + 1 - (intervalLength + middleLength)));
        std::fill_n(data.data(), std::min<int>(data.size(), intervalLength + middleLength), INF);

        int minX = interval[1] - middleLength - intervalLength;
        int maxX = interval[1] - middleLength;

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int minNeedTime = Node::query(minX - j, maxX - j, 0, n, lastDp);
            data[j] = std::min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int minNeedTime = Node::query(j - middleLength - intervalLength, j - middleLength, 0, n, lastDp);
            data[j] = std::min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
        }

        Node::fromArray(0, n, data.data(), curDp);
    }

    int minFlipTime = Node::query(n, n, 0, n, loop[k & 1]);

    if (minFlipTime < INF) {
        cout << "Full\n" << minFlipTime << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
